all_rows.reason: Foundational proposal of MSP explanation for GCE; directly supports the claim that Abazajian first proposed this hypothesis.

all_rows.paragraph: The first constraint comes from scaling the observed relationship between low-mass X-ray binaries (LMXBs) and MSPs.
